ABNB.headline: Airbnb Announces New Funding Model for Airbnb.org
ABNB.summary: Airbnb has introduced a new funding mechanism where a portion of revenue from every booking will support its nonprofit arm, Airbnb.org, aiming to provide $500 million in funding over five years.

ABNB.headline: Airbnb Supports Playing for Keeps Foundation Initiative
ABNB.summary: Airbnb has provided funding to the Playing for Keeps Foundation to support the development of quality play spaces in underserved communities.

ABNB.headline: Oppenheimer Maintains Outperform on Airbnb, Raises Price Target to $210
Oppenheimer Adjusts Airbnb Price Target to $210 From $190
ABNB.summary: Oppenheimer has raised its price target for Airbnb, Inc. from $190 to $210 while maintaining an Outperform rating.

ABNB.headline: American Express Raises Profit Outlook, But Layoff Plans and Rising Costs Draw Scrutiny
ABNB.summary: American Express reports strong Q3 results and raises guidance, yet shares dip as the company plans to lay off 5% of its workforce.
